subject: Partner-led demo: technical deep-dive & next steps (CloudBridge)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Anjali Singh <anjali@cloudbridge.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner-led demo: technical deep-dive & next steps (CloudBridge)

Hi Anjali / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the call today with Camila and me. Really excited about the opportunity to work together on the marketplace integration and the GSI co-sell motion. Per our conversation, the next step is a technical deep-dive/demo with engineering to validate the integration points (S3 provisioning for model artifacts, SSO/KMS flow, and routing for private deployments).

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue May 4: 10:00-11:00am
- Wed May 5: 1:00-2:00pm
- Thu May 6: 8:30-9:30am

Please let us know which of these works best for your team or share a couple of alternatives. I’ve included Camila from our partnerships engineering team on the thread — she will lead the technical walkthrough.

Attaching the partner overview deck and a short pre-demo questionnaire that will help us tailor the session. Also sharing a Calendly link if you prefer to pick a slot there.

Agenda (30-45 min):
- 5 min: introductions and objective alignment
- 20-30 min: technical demo / integration considerations
- 10 min: next steps / action items (mutual action plan)

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: partner-deck-cloudbridge.pdf, pre-demo-questionnaire.docx

From: Anjali Singh <anjali@cloudbridge.com>

Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-led demo: technical deep-dive & next steps (CloudBridge)

Hi Marissa (and Camila),

Thanks — great summary and clear agenda. Wed May 5 1:00-2:00pm PDT works best for our engineering and product leads (I'll include them on the calendar invite once you confirm). If Camila wants the deeper infra folks, we can also loop in our infra lead, Tom (cc'd).

A couple quick notes/questions ahead of the session:
- For KMS/SSE, we run customer-managed keys in some enterprise accounts — is there a Redwood runbook or example integration guide you can share?
- We'll review the pre-demo questionnaire and send answers by EOD Tuesday.

I'll hold the time on our side tentatively once you confirm. Thanks!

Best,
Anjali Singh
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge
anjali@cloudbridge.com | +1 650-555-7620
